findings.claim: `failureCodes` is a flat code->count map, and since `cancelled` is the one code the schema deliberately allows on both sides of dispatch (:46-57, :230-247), its pre- vs post-dispatch split is only recoverable by subtracting the stage-fixed codes from `outcomes.refusedBeforeDispatch` and `dispatchedFailures` rather than being stated.
findings.reproduction: summarizePromptRefinerReceipts on a bundle holding one `refused_before_dispatch` receipt with failureCode `cancelled` (dispatchedAt null, failureLayer `adapter`) and one dispatched `failed` receipt with failureCode `cancelled` (failureLayer `provider`) returns `failureCodes: { cancelled: 2 }`; expected, per docs/policy/prompt-refiner-observability.md §2 ('code만으로 단계를 주장하지 않고 dispatchedAt과 outcome이 그 lifecycle을 결정한다'), a split keyed by outcome, e.g. `{ cancelled: { beforeDispatch: 1, afterDispatch: 1 } }`.

verdict.nextAction: Round-1's failureCode/lifecycle finding is closed by PRE_DISPATCH_ONLY_FAILURE_CODES and POST_DISPATCH_ONLY_FAILURE_CODES at lib/promptRefinerReceiptCore.ts:230-247 with matching negative tests, every completion criterion is met and all reported guards pass, so merge as is and optionally split the `cancelled` bucket by outcome in a later round.
